{{Otheruses|Ranger}}
The '''Rangers''' were an elite security force that protected the personnel and equipment of [[Galentro Heavy Works]]. They traveled in unmarked [[Starship/Legends|starships]] with forged identifications. They guarded critical Galentro installations and personnel, including [[Wyrn Otro]].
